question: What is the difference in 'Change %' between the second-ranked and third-ranked industries under the 'Monthly' category?

steps.description: Locate the 'Monthly' category and find the second-ranked industry 'Software & Services', then read its Monthly value
In the 'Monthly' category, locate the 'Software & Services' row and read its 'Change %' value
Locate the 'Monthly' category and find the third-ranked industry 'Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences', then read its Monthly value
In the 'Monthly' category, locate the 'Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences' row and read its 'Change %' value
Subtract the Change % value from step_4 from the Change % value from step_2 to find the difference
